title: OSSE_CrossModel_Analysis: cross-model analysis and figure scripts for the AI weather model truth-insertion OSSE study
description:
OSSE_CrossModel_Analysis: cross-model analysis and figure scripts for the AI weather model truth-insertion OSSE study.

Code release accompanying the manuscript An AI-Based OSSE Framework to Evaluate Learned Physical Consistency: A Multi-Model Study Using FourCastNet, Aurora, Prithvi WxC, and GraphCast (Diggikar, Halem, and Raman; submitted to AGU Journal of Geophysical Research: Machine Learning and Computation).
